name: squirrelscan
title_zh: 260 条规则扫完网站，健康分和问题清单一起给
tagline_zh: SEO、性能、安全、无障碍、内容、结构化数据一次查完。不只看分数，每条问题都告诉你改哪里，像请了个全科体检医生。
tagline_en: SEO, speed, security, a11y, content & schema in one pass. Not just a score—each issue tells you exactly what to.
desc_en: squirrelscan audits websites for SEO, performance, security, accessibility, content, and structured data issues (260+ rules) and scores site health, via the squirrel CLI. Use when the user wants to check, audit, or improve a website's SEO, ranking, speed, or health, and for anything squirrelscan itself, installing or updating the CLI, login and API keys, running audits, publishing and sharing repo
why_zh: 260+ 条规则覆盖六类维度，输出可共享的仓库报告。不是单页快检，是整站体检后给你一张能照着改的清单。
why_en: 260+ rules across six dimensions, output as a shareable repo report. Not a one-page quick check—a whole-site exam with a fix-it.
limit_zh: 只审计公开可访问的 URL，需能联网抓取；不处理需登录的页面、SPA 动态渲染内容、或 JS 重度依赖站点。
limit_en: Audits only publicly reachable URLs; no login-gated pages, SPA-rendered or JS-heavy content. Report is a snapshot, not continuous monitoring.
title_en: 260+ rule website audit with health score & issue list
